newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello says wages a concern, cautions on rates.
newsitem.headline: Costello says wages a concern, cautions on rates.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello declined on Wednesday to speculate on the prospects of another interest rate cut but pointed to wages as an area of concern.
In response to a question from the media during a door stop in Perth, Costello noted there had already been three interest rate cuts since the Howard government was elected in March 1996.
"We have (also) got a good inflation forecast, " Costello said. "We've got a budget that is coming back into surplus and the only area of concern we have is wages."

"We have got to keep a very careful look at wage outcomes - and I think we'll be getting some further data later this week - but the point I would stress before you start speculating on future movements in interest rates, remember we have already had three cuts since our government was elected," he said.
